name: Continuous Delivery 
jobs:

  buildDocker:
    name: Build Docker Images
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.variant.runner }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        variant:
          - platform: linux/arm/v6
            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
          - platform: linux/arm/v7
            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
          - platform: linux/arm64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
          - platform: linux/386
            runner: ubuntu-24.04
          - platform: linux/amd64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v6
    - name: Docker builder
      uses: ./.github/actions/docker-builder
      with:
        platform: ${{ matrix.variant.platform }}
        docker-username: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}
        docker-password: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_PASSWORD }}

  mergeDocker:
    name: Merge Docker Images
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    needs: buildDocker
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Docker merge
        uses: ./.github/actions/docker-merge
        with:
          docker-username: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}
          docker-password: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_PASSWORD }}

  buildNightlyMSYS2:
    name: Build and export native Windows version
    runs-on: windows-2025
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      with:
        submodules: true
    - name: Setup MSYS2 UCRT64
      uses: msys2/setup-msys2@v2
      with:
        msystem: UCRT64
        update: true
        cache: false
    - name: Install deps
      shell: msys2 {0}
      run: |
        ./tools/build/windows/install-deps.sh
    - name: Build
      shell: msys2 {0}
      run: |
        ./tools/build/windows/install.sh
        ./tools/build/windows/cleanup.sh
        ./tools/build/windows/create-dist.sh
    - name: Enable UTF-8
      run: ./tools/build/windows/utf8-support.ps1
    - name: Find MSBuild
      uses: microsoft/setup-msbuild@v3
    - name: Build MSI Installer
      run: |
        choco uninstall wixtoolset
        ./tools/build/windows/build-installer.ps1
    - name: Upload Installer
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
      with:
        name: LANraragi.msi
        path: ./tools/build/windows/Karen/Setup/bin/LANraragi.msi
        if-no-files-found: error

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
